CREATE TABLE "Usuario" (
    "Id" integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    "Nome" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    "Telefone" character varying(20),
    "Email" text NOT NULL,
    "SenhaHash" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    "DataCriacao" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
    CONSTRAINT "PK_Usuario" PRIMARY KEY ("Id")
);

CREATE TABLE "MembroEquipe" (
    "Id" integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    "DataEntrada" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    "Cargo" "Cargo" NOT NULL,
    "UsuarioId" integer NOT NULL,
    "EquipeId" integer NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "PK_MembroEquipe" PRIMARY KEY ("Id"),
    CONSTRAINT "FK_MembroEquipe_Equipe_EquipeId" FOREIGN KEY ("EquipeId") REFERENCES "Equipe" ("Id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT "FK_MembroEquipe_Usuario_UsuarioId" FOREIGN KEY ("UsuarioId") REFERENCES "Usuario" ("Id") ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE "Tarefa" (
    "Id" integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    "Titulo" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    "Descricao" character varying(1000),
    "DataVencimento" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    "Pontuacao" integer,
    "Status" "Status" NOT NULL,
    "Prioridade" "Prioridade" NOT NULL,
    "CriadorId" integer NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "PK_Tarefa" PRIMARY KEY ("Id"),
    CONSTRAINT "FK_Tarefa_Usuario_CriadorId" FOREIGN KEY ("CriadorId") REFERENCES "Usuario" ("Id") ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE "Meta" (
    "Id" integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    "Nome" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    "DataFechamento" timestamp with time zone,
    "Concluida" boolean,
    "TarefaId" integer NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT "FK_Meta_Tarefa_TarefaId" FOREIGN KEY ("TarefaId") REFERENCES "Tarefa" ("Id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT "FK_Meta_Usuario_UsuarioId" FOREIGN KEY ("UsuarioId") REFERENCES "Usuario" ("Id") ON DELETE CASCADE
);

);

CREATE TABLE "Sugestao" (

SELECT t."Id", t."CriadorId", t."DataVencimento", t."Descricao", t."Pontuacao", t."Prioridade", t."Status", t."Titulo", r."Id", r."TarefaId", r."UsuarioId"
FROM "Tarefa" AS t
LEFT JOIN "ResponsavelTarefa" AS r ON t."Id" = r."TarefaId"
WHERE t."Status" = 'pendente'::"Status" AND t."DataVencimento" >= @dataReferencia
ORDER BY t."Id"

SELECT t."Id", t."CriadorId", t."DataVencimento", t."Descricao", t."Pontuacao", t."Prioridade", t."Status", t."Titulo", s."Id", s."TarefaId", s."UsuarioId", s."Id0", s."CodigoVerificacaoExpiracao", s."CodigoVerificacaoHash", s."DataCriacao", s."Email", s."EmailVerificado", s."Nome", s."SenhaHash", s."Telefone"
FROM "Tarefa" AS t
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT r."Id", r."TarefaId", r."UsuarioId", u."Id" AS "Id0", u."CodigoVerificacaoExpiracao", u."CodigoVerificacaoHash", u."DataCriacao", u."Email", u."EmailVerificado", u."Nome", u."SenhaHash", u."Telefone"
    FROM "ResponsavelTarefa" AS r
    INNER JOIN "Usuario" AS u ON r."UsuarioId" = u."Id"
) AS s ON t."Id" = s."TarefaId"
WHERE t."Status" = 'pendente'::"Status" AND t."DataVencimento" < @dataReferencia
ORDER BY t."Id", s."Id"
